messages.author: 17e30776ec2a7fb1
messages.subject: Re: [sqldf] RSQLite.extfuns
parts:
T'he functionality of RSQLite.extfuns was moved into the RSQLite
package and so SQLite.extfuns longer exists as a separate package on
CRAN (older versions are still available in the archive). The latest
sqldf, therefore, does not use RQLite.extfuns either.

messages.author: 17e30776ec2a7fb1
messages.subject: Re: [sqldf] RSQLite.extfuns
parts:
The latest version of sqldf is 0.4-10.   Also make sure you have all the latest dependencies (including R 3.1.0 or later) as listed here:
http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/sqldf/index.html

If for some reason you need to use an older version of R then use the checkpoint package as discussed in the Latest News on the sqldf home page.
http://sqldf.googlecode.com
